# Tuteliq Homebrew Tap

> Homebrew tap for installing the Tuteliq CLI on macOS and Linux.

## What is this?
A Homebrew tap that provides an easy way to install the Tuteliq CLI tool on macOS and Linux systems.

## Install
brew tap Tuteliq/tap
brew install tuteliq

## Usage
After installation, use the tuteliq command:
export TUTELIQ_API_KEY=tq_your_key
tuteliq detect unsafe --text "message to check" --age-group 13-15

## Verification Features (Beta)

### Age Verification
- Tier: Pro ($99/mo)+
- Credits: 5 per request
- Endpoint: POST /v1/verification/age
- Methods: document, biometric, combined
- CLI: tuteliq verify age --document id-front.jpg --method document

### Identity Verification
- Tier: Business ($349/mo)+
- Credits: 10 per request
- Endpoint: POST /v1/verification/identity
- CLI: tuteliq verify identity --document id-front.jpg --selfie selfie.jpg
